title: Construct rank-one tail connectivity with exact vector conductances
statement: Add each enabled-line stationary adjoint z->y at rate kappa*c^(y-z), halving both directions; the labelled Dirichlet energy D=Z E is unchanged and weak reversibility keeps each adjoint connection in the original class. Let g=gcd|h_r| and use a negative-first Bezout word of net+g, pre-offsets s_j<=0, source Y_j. Compute A0 so a_i+v_i A0>=(Y_j)_i-s_j v_i on every growing coordinate. Then gamma_j(k)=beta_j*w(x(k))*product_i(x_i(k))_((Y_j)_i-s_j v_i)>=beta_j*w(x(k)), beta_j=(hat kappa_j/2)c^(s_j v)>0, exactly. Choose A congruent k0 mod g above A0 and ceil(2max(1,c^v)). The word/reverse connect all x(A+gN), whose weight ratio is <=[c^v/(k+1)^(sum v_i)]^g<=1/2. Enumerate congruent prefix k<A plus one collapsed connected tail node and every boundary edge. Its k0 component is the EXACT finite class or whole tail plus its listed prefix; no class oracle or unbounded search is used.
